purpose: Defines the 22 single-pass streaming accumulators and telemetry analytics engine for computing behavioral, economic, and operational metrics across agent transcripts in O(N) linear time.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-analysis: RawMessageAccumulator and EntryAccumulator traits, 22 accumulators (token_usage, circuit_breaker, mcp_affinity, flow, turn_duration, tool_inventory, context_growth, permission_mode, hook_activity, api_health, pr_link, fuzzy_tools, attribution, self_correction, autonomy, schema_extractor, stats, timeline, artifacts, otel_correlation, span_mapping, trajectory_dag), and subagent attribution.
non_goals: Log file format parsing or I/O streaming (handled by lumen-session).
Tarjan SCC cycle graph algorithms (handled by lumen-pattern).
Writing to disk or external databases (pure computation engine).

api_surface.name: RawMessageAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub trait RawMessageAccumulator { type Output: Serialize + Send; fn update_raw(&mut self, message: &serde_json::Value); fn finalize(self) -> Self::Output; }
api_surface.description: Lifecycle contract for single-pass stream accumulators operating on raw JSON frames.
error_conditions: Must handle missing keys without panicking

api_surface.name: EntryAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub trait EntryAccumulator { type Output: Serialize + Send; fn update(&mut self, entry: &CanonicalTurn); fn finalize(self) -> Self::Output; }
api_surface.description: Lifecycle contract for single-pass stream accumulators operating on semantic CanonicalTurn structs.

api_surface.name: TokenUsageAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub struct TokenUsageAccumulator { pub input_tokens: u64, pub output_tokens: u64, pub cache_creation_tokens: u64, pub cache_read_tokens: u64, pub per_model: BTreeMap<CompactString, ModelTokenSummary>, pub turns: u64 }; impl TokenUsageAccumulator { pub fn update_raw(&mut self, message: &serde_json::Value); pub fn finalize(self) -> TokenEconomics; }
api_surface.description: Single-pass token accountant tracking ephemeral 5m/1h cache writes, cache reads, and exact USD costs.

api_surface.name: CircuitBreakerAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub struct CircuitBreakerAccumulator { pub max_observed_rounds: usize, pub stalls: Vec<CircuitStallEvent> }; impl CircuitBreakerAccumulator { pub fn update(&mut self, entry: &CanonicalTurn); pub fn finalize(self) -> CircuitBreakerReport; }
api_surface.description: Tracks multi-agent consensus iterations (e.g. Drafter and Auditor) and detects review stalls exceeding 2 rounds.

api_surface.name: SchemaExtractorAccumulator
api_surface.signature: pub struct SchemaExtractorAccumulator { pub extracted: Vec<SchemaCitation> }; impl SchemaExtractorAccumulator { pub fn update(&mut self, entry: &CanonicalTurn); pub fn finalize(self) -> Vec<SchemaCitation>; }
api_surface.description: Extracts and validates embedded JSON schema artifacts (spec@1, plan@1, changeset@1, eval-report@1) against Draft-07 schemas.
error_conditions: Flags is_valid = false if extracted JSON violates schema

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN processing a session stream, THE SYSTEM SHALL execute all 22 accumulators in a single linear pass over the messages in O(N) time with zero heap allocations in the inner loop.
WHEN TokenUsageAccumulator processes an assistant message with usage, THE SYSTEM SHALL add input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens to running totals.
WHEN CircuitBreakerAccumulator detects consecutive review handoffs between the same agent pair, THE SYSTEM SHALL increment the round counter and flag a CircuitStallEvent if rounds exceed 2.
WHEN SchemaExtractorAccumulator encounters an embedded JSON block matching a known schema ID, THE SYSTEM SHALL validate the payload against Draft-07 and record a SchemaCitation.
WHEN TurnDurationAccumulator processes message timestamps, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute p50, p95, and average turn latency across all assistant completions.
WHEN ApiHealthAccumulator encounters a 429 rate limit or 5xx server error, THE SYSTEM SHALL record the error code, retry count, and retry latency in milliseconds.
WHEN McpAffinityAccumulator audits tool invocations, THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate the ratio of structured MCP queries versus fallback raw shell commands.
WHEN SelfCorrectionAccumulator observes a tool failure followed immediately by an adjusted parameter retry, THE SYSTEM SHALL record a tool_retry self-correction event.
IF a transcript contains synthetic model strings (starting with <synthetic>), THE SYSTEM SHALL silently exclude them from ModelTokenSummary billing.
WHEN subagent transcripts are processed, THE SYSTEM SHALL aggregate token spend by subagent role and compute the hierarchical economics breakdown.

reasoning: Specifies the complete 22-accumulator analytics engine for extracting behavioral telemetry, circuit breaker dynamics, and token economics in a single pass.
